title: The interruption
purpose: كسر نمط محتوى الوكالات المعتاد وطرح سؤال يلفت انتباه صاحب القرار: هل التسويق يتحرك أم يستهلك وقتاً وميزانية؟
hook_ar: مش كل حركة… معناها إنك بتتقدم.
core_ar:

قول. تم.

At SayTamm, we start with the objective and connect strategy, creative, media and technology in one plan. Activity is not the same as impact. Visibility is not the same as growth.

State the objective. We start there.

Say it. Tamm it.

prompt:
PROJECT: SayTamm launch — Day 01: The interruption
FORMAT: AI-generated motion film
CONTENT PILLAR: Smart diagnosis
SINGLE-MINDED PURPOSE: كسر نمط محتوى الوكالات المعتاد وطرح سؤال يلفت انتباه صاحب القرار: هل التسويق يتحرك أم يستهلك وقتاً وميزانية؟
OPENING HOOK (AR): مش كل حركة… معناها إنك بتتقدم.
OPENING HOOK (EN): Not all movement means progress.

CREATIVE CONCEPT:
A surreal editorial interruption: a perfectly ordered stream of marketing outputs (posts, ad tiles, charts) moves rapidly on a dark conveyor, then stops abruptly at one simple business question set in typography. No fake data or readable dashboard UI. End on the supplied SayTamm logo lockup.

MOTION / EDITING DIRECTION:
10–12 sec, 9:16 master. 0–2s rapid but controlled sequence of abstract content tiles; 2–4s hard silence and freeze; 4–7s the question appears; 7–10s tiles reorganise into a single connected path; final 1.5s brand lockup.

TAMM CHARACTER DIRECTION:
No TAMM character. Keep the opening conceptual and editorial; reveal brand at the end only.

SOUND DIRECTION:
Precision sound design: restrained mechanical rhythm, abrupt near-silence at the interruption, one low impact on the question, clean resolve. No EDM drop or stock corporate music.

BRAND / FACTUAL NON-NEGOTIABLES:
Use SayTamm's Dark Editorial Performance system: Black #0A0A0D, White #FFFFFF, Electric Purple #6C35FF as a restrained accent (target about 10% or less), supported by Neutral #F5F5F7 / #A4A4AE / #17171C. English type: Satoshi. Arabic type: IBM Plex Sans Arabic. Premium editorial, confident hierarchy, generous negative space, purposeful motion.
Use only supplied official SayTamm logo artwork. NEVER redraw, approximate, regenerate, distort, rotate, recolour, add shadow/gradient, or mirror its diagonal. Insert logo in post from the supplied master asset on a solid approved background. Do not ask an image/video model to render legible Arabic or English typography; add typography in post. Do not use generic stock people, fabricated team/office footage, fake dashboards, invented metrics, client logos, or AI-generated client campaign examples. AI imagery is decorative/conceptual only. No neon overload, glow effects, particles, generic agency templates, or cliché city montages. Keep Arabic composition natively RTL; never mirror the English layout.

MULTIDISCIPLINARY CREATIVE EXECUTION — mandatory role ownership:
• Creative Director: protect the single-minded idea, emotional arc, originality and brand distinction. Reject generic agency tropes.
• Art Director: define composition, visual metaphor, lighting, camera language, negative space, hierarchy and visual continuity.
• Social Media Head: make the first 1–2 seconds / first carousel slide stop the scroll; design native crops, safe zones, subtitle pacing and platform adaptations.
• Content Head: protect the message, clarity, factual accuracy, bilingual meaning and the hook-to-payoff structure.
• Digital Strategist: ensure the asset communicates a real business insight and supports the launch funnel; do not promise outcomes or fabricate proof.
• Senior Graphic Designer: execute a strict grid, typography, contrast, spacing and legibility system; add all final text in post-production, not inside generative imagery.
• AI Video Specialist: generate controlled shots with reference locking, shot continuity, motion constraints and clean plates; avoid morphing, text hallucination and logo distortion.
• Social Video Editor: edit for retention, rhythm, captions, sound, platform-safe framing and a decisive end frame. Deliver clean masters and platform exports.

PRODUCTION PLAN:
1. Pre-production: lock the message, approved logo file, type system, aspect ratios and references. Build an asset list and storyboard before generation.
2. Generation: create clean visual plates without text or logos. Generate shots separately when this improves control. Use image/reference conditioning for the approved TAMM design when specified. Preserve object identity, geometry and lighting across shots.
3. Design: set final Arabic and English typography separately. Arabic is not a line-by-line mirror; compose it natively RTL. Keep all critical copy inside platform-safe zones.
4. Edit: create a strong first frame, remove dead air, maintain a clear visual progression, use accurate subtitles and finish with a legible CTA / approved brand lockup.
5. QA: review spelling, Arabic shaping, English British spelling, logo geometry, character continuity, factual claims, mobile legibility, audio peaks, safe margins and platform exports.

DELIVERABLES:
• Master visual: 9:16 vertical master; add 16:9 only where the concept requires it.
• Separate Arabic and English text layers / exports; do not combine both scripts into a crowded single frame.
• Clean version without captions plus captioned version.
• Editable project/source file and final high-quality export.
• Thumbnail / cover frame with the hook readable at phone size.

NEGATIVE PROMPT / REJECT IF:
misspelled text, pseudo-Arabic, broken glyphs, distorted logo, mirrored diagonal, changed TAMM face or body, extra fingers/limbs, unstable hands, flicker, morphing, warped geometry, random UI, fabricated numbers, stock-photo look, clutter, excessive purple, neon glow, particles, fake office, fake employees, fake client work, generic handshake imagery, weak opening frame, tiny text, unsafe crop, or a CTA that cannot be read.

title: Meet TAMM
purpose: تقديم تم كشخصية مساعدة ذكية تمثل طريقة التفكير والتنفيذ، لا كبديل عن خبرة الفريق.
hook_ar: ده تم. مش جاي ياخد مكان الفريق… جاي يوضح طريقة تفكيرنا.
hook_en: Meet TAMM. Not a replacement for the team — a reflection of how we think.
core_ar:
ده «تم».

شخصية بتجسّد طريقة شغلنا: نفهم المطلوب، نرتّب الأولويات، ونحوّل الفكرة لخطوات واضحة.

لكن خلّيها واضحة: «تم» مش هو الفريق، ومش بديل عن الخبرة البشرية. هو رفيق بصري لطريقة تفكير قائمة على الوضوح، الدقة، وتحمل المسؤولية.

أهلاً بيك في عالم قول تم.

قول. تم.
core_en:
Meet TAMM.

A character built to represent the way we work: understand the brief, organise the priorities and turn an idea into clear next steps.

One thing matters: TAMM is not the team, and never a substitute for human expertise. It is a visual companion to a way of thinking built on clarity, precision and ownership.

Welcome to SayTamm.

Say it. Tamm it.
visual: Use the approved TAMM reference image as the only character identity source. TAMM stands in a restrained dark editorial studio, introduces three floating typographic words: Clarity / Precision / Ownership. Keep the exact helmet, visor, proportions, shell, approved logo placement and purple accents. Avoid changing the robot design.
motion: 8–10 sec, 9:16. Slow confident camera push. TAMM enters frame, turns to camera, gestures to three clean type panels; finish with character beside brand lockup. Animate hands subtly; no exaggerated cartoon bounce.
tamm: Hero character usage. Use provided reference image(s) for image-to-video or character reference. Never invent a new face, helmet, body proportions or logo.
sound: Warm minimal electronic score, subtle servo movement and clean UI ticks. TAMM voice optional; if used, calm, concise, not childish.

purpose: تقديم نصيحة قصيرة قابلة للتطبيق بصوت المؤسس، وتأكيد أن الإنفاق الإعلاني يبدأ من جاهزية العرض ومسار التحويل.
hook_ar: قبل ما تزود الميزانية… راجع 3 حاجات.
hook_en: Before increasing the budget, check three things.
core_ar:
قبل ما تزود ميزانية الإعلانات، راجع 3 حاجات:

1. هل العرض واضح ومقنع؟
2. هل صفحة الهبوط بتكمّل نفس الوعد اللي الإعلان قاله؟
3. هل تقدر تقيس اللي بيحصل بعد الضغط، مش الضغط بس؟

لو واحدة من دول فيها مشكلة، زيادة الميزانية ممكن تكبّر المشكلة بدل ما تحلّها.

ابدأ بالتشخيص… وبعدها قرر تزود ولا تغيّر.
core_en:
Before increasing your ad budget, check three things:

1. Is the offer clear and compelling?
2. Does the landing page continue the promise made in the ad?
3. Can you measure what happens after the click — not just the click itself?

If one of these is weak, more budget may amplify the problem rather than solve it.

Diagnose first. Then decide whether to scale or change direction.
visual: Founder speaking directly to camera, eye-level, clean uncluttered background. AI-assisted edit adds three numbered typographic callouts beside the speaker, not over the face. Use real footage as truth source; do not generate or alter the founder's face.

tamm: No TAMM character. Human authority is the creative asset.
sound: Clean lavalier or phone audio, noise reduction, subtle low-volume bed. No synthetic voice replacement.

CAC: Customer Acquisition Cost.

CVR: Conversion Rate.

title: Smart tip 02 — Read the report backwards
ar: نصيحة ذكية 02 — اقرأ التقرير من الآخر
purpose: تقديم طريقة عملية لتحويل التقرير الشهري إلى قرارات قابلة للتنفيذ بدلاً من الاكتفاء بعرض الأرقام.
hook_ar: لو التقرير مفيهوش قرار… غالباً لسه ناقصه أهم جزء.
hook_en: If a report ends without a decision, it may be missing its most important part.
core_ar:
جرّب تقرأ تقرير التسويق من الآخر.

قبل ما تبدأ في الأرقام، دور على 3 إجابات:
1. إيه اللي اتعلمناه؟
2. إيه اللي محتاج يتغير؟
3. إيه القرار اللي هناخده في الفترة الجاية؟

بعدها ارجع للأرقام وشوف هل هي بتدعم القرار ده ولا لأ.

التقرير الجيد مش مجرد توثيق للي حصل. هو بداية لقرار أذكى.

Try reading your marketing report backwards.

Before diving into the numbers, look for three answers:
1. What did we learn?
2. What needs to change?
3. What decision will we make next?

Then go back to the data and check whether it supports that decision.

A useful report does more than document what happened. It starts a smarter next move.

PROJECT: SayTamm launch — Day 13: The team behind TAMM
FORMAT: Founder-shot brand story / team-led reel
CONTENT PILLAR: Experience & people
SINGLE-MINDED PURPOSE: توضيح أن الشخصية البصرية لا تمثل بديلاً عن الأشخاص، وأن قيمة قول تم في جمع تخصصات وخبرات تعمل على نفس الهدف.
OPENING HOOK (AR): تم شخصية… لكن الشغل وراه ناس وخبرة.
OPENING HOOK (EN): TAMM is a character. The work behind it is human.

CREATIVE CONCEPT:
Real, consented footage of actual team members only. If team footage is unavailable, use a typographic discipline-led composition instead of AI-generated people. TAMM appears as a small framing device, not as a substitute for the team.

MOTION / EDITING DIRECTION:
20–25 sec, 9:16. Founder opening line; fast but readable labels for the four disciplines; insert authentic team/work footage if cleared; close with SayTamm brand lockup. No fabricated office shots.

TAMM CHARACTER DIRECTION:
Supporting role only. Keep character to opening/closing beat; do not portray it as the actual workforce.

SOUND DIRECTION:
Natural voice and authentic ambient sound. Avoid stock team-building music.

BRAND / FACTUAL NON-NEGOTIABLES:
Use SayTamm's Dark Editorial Performance system: Black #0A0A0D, White #FFFFFF, Electric Purple #6C35FF as a restrained accent (target about 10% or less), supported by Neutral #F5F5F7 / #A4A4AE / #17171C. English type: Satoshi. Arabic type: IBM Plex Sans Arabic. Premium editorial, confident hierarchy, generous negative space, purposeful motion.
Use only supplied official SayTamm logo artwork. NEVER redraw, approximate, regenerate, distort, rotate, recolour, add shadow/gradient, or mirror its diagonal. Insert logo in post from the supplied master asset on a solid approved background. Do not ask an image/video model to render legible Arabic or English typography; add typography in post. Do not use generic stock people, fabricated team/office footage, fake dashboards, invented metrics, client logos, or AI-generated client campaign examples. AI imagery is decorative/conceptual only. No neon overload, glow effects, particles, generic agency templates, or cliché city montages. Keep Arabic composition natively RTL; never mirror the English layout.

MULTIDISCIPLINARY CREATIVE EXECUTION — mandatory role ownership:
• Creative Director: protect the single-minded idea, emotional arc, originality and brand distinction. Reject generic agency tropes.
• Art Director: define composition, visual metaphor, lighting, camera language, negative space, hierarchy and visual continuity.
• Social Media Head: make the first 1–2 seconds / first carousel slide stop the scroll; design native crops, safe zones, subtitle pacing and platform adaptations.
• Content Head: protect the message, clarity, factual accuracy, bilingual meaning and the hook-to-payoff structure.
• Digital Strategist: ensure the asset communicates a real business insight and supports the launch funnel; do not promise outcomes or fabricate proof.
• Senior Graphic Designer: execute a strict grid, typography, contrast, spacing and legibility system; add all final text in post-production, not inside generative imagery.
• AI Video Specialist: generate controlled shots with reference locking, shot continuity, motion constraints and clean plates; avoid morphing, text hallucination and logo distortion.
• Social Video Editor: edit for retention, rhythm, captions, sound, platform-safe framing and a decisive end frame. Deliver clean masters and platform exports.

PRODUCTION PLAN:
1. Pre-production: lock the message, approved logo file, type system, aspect ratios and references. Build an asset list and storyboard before generation.
2. Generation: create clean visual plates without text or logos. Generate shots separately when this improves control. Use image/reference conditioning for the approved TAMM design when specified. Preserve object identity, geometry and lighting across shots.
3. Design: set final Arabic and English typography separately. Arabic is not a line-by-line mirror; compose it natively RTL. Keep all critical copy inside platform-safe zones.
4. Edit: create a strong first frame, remove dead air, maintain a clear visual progression, use accurate subtitles and finish with a legible CTA / approved brand lockup.
5. QA: review spelling, Arabic shaping, English British spelling, logo geometry, character continuity, factual claims, mobile legibility, audio peaks, safe margins and platform exports.

DELIVERABLES:
• Master visual: 9:16 vertical master; add 16:9 only where the concept requires it.
• Separate Arabic and English text layers / exports; do not combine both scripts into a crowded single frame.
• Clean version without captions plus captioned version.
• Editable project/source file and final high-quality export.
• Thumbnail / cover frame with the hook readable at phone size.

NEGATIVE PROMPT / REJECT IF:
misspelled text, pseudo-Arabic, broken glyphs, distorted logo, mirrored diagonal, changed TAMM face or body, extra fingers/limbs, unstable hands, flicker, morphing, warped geometry, random UI, fabricated numbers, stock-photo look, clutter, excessive purple, neon glow, particles, fake office, fake employees, fake client work, generic handshake imagery, weak opening frame, tiny text, unsafe crop, or a CTA that cannot be read.
